'''Keshani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Quesh war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]], she was stationed at the [[Republic Operational Headquarters]], where she ran the small [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the base.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keshani appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Cantina Vendor for Republic players on Quesh.<ref name="TOR" />
